description: Never leave an unclosed <style> tag in index.html (causes browser to treat scripts as styles and print raw code onto the screen)
Never leave an unclosed <script> tag in index.html
Never include HTML tags like <style> or </style> inside css/styles.css
Never include HTML tags like <script> or </script> inside standalone .js files
Never print raw JavaScript code text into the HTML body outside of script tags
Never declare var/let/const commonFoodsDatabase in js/nutrition.js (declared as const in data/usda-foods.js)

Never use position:fixed with conflicting h-[100dvh] on body for bottom docks; use natural flex flow with min-height: -webkit-fill-available and verify GitHub Pages deployment build before notifying user
Never automatically run estimateMicronutrientsForFood when opening openManualNutritionModal; only supplement nutrients after user approves USDA supplementation prompt
Never leave barcode scanner camera tracks running without calling stopBarcodeCamera
